trajectory: [0,4) stationary; [4,12) forward; [12,20) forward+lateral+turn; [20,27) reverse+lateral+opposite turn; [27,34) forward+opposite lateral+turn; [34,40] stationary; Car2 scales vx .8, vy -1, yaw rate -.8. Initial near +/-pi, nonzero unequal levers from synthetic_config.json.

generator.odom_pose: generator integrates previous noisy twist; independent implementation; not truth observation
generator.noise_model_limit: synthetic independent draws, despite possible shared real upstream processing; stationary nominal noisy velocity means only exact-zero-input unit test establishes strict unobservability
generator.timevarying_bias: initial +0.010/-0.010 rad/s + RW .0015 (rad/s)/sqrt(s) + .010*sin(t/6) rad/s; deliberately mismatched assumed RW
generator.velocity_slip: Car1 noisy vx/vy scaled1.2 plus vy .04m/s on [10,24)s; odom pose reflects same slip
generator.weak_wall: Car2 retains only node_2 wall and directed peer for whole run
generator.stationary_unobservable: zero true motion, zero XY lever, same constant gyro bias, all walls; noisy measured velocity retained
generator.straight_weak_observability: straight 0.12m/s [4,34)s, zero true turn/lateral; Car2 one wall; same constant gyro bias
generator.gyro_axis_mismatch: Car1 true gyro sign flipped including noise, declared axis intentionally unchanged; no auto-repair

estimator.configuration: synthetic_config.json with only frozen per-scenario zero-lever variant and mode/enabled changes
estimator.gap_recovery: explicit held-mean reanchor with engineering inflation, persistent unknown-displacement flag; no interpolation or odom-yaw fallback

metrics: XY RMSE at publication epoch clamped to truth coverage
same input/config comparison and compute cost
evaluation.truth_access: offline evaluator only; input wrappers do not include true pose, bias or fault labels
evaluation.timing: all source/receive/state/publication epoch ns exact integers; full covariance in serialized decisions; pose marginal3x3 in CSV
evaluation.denominator: per vehicle40s, publication intervals clipped to truth[0,40]; first3ms before first arrival count unavailable; frames not independent experiments
evaluation.readback: all output SHA, all control identities, all propagation means and independent cross blocks; F/Q and H/Joseph every113th serialized occurrence per CLI run
evaluation.success_rule: no mandatory improvement; preserve all worse/weak/failed outcomes; no thresholds adjusted from matrix

resume_rule: only exact source map/protocol SHA and completed output/input hash match; never silently rerun or overwrite a completed/failed cell
